scriptWithTimestamps:
00:00:00:01 - 00:00:01:19
Clicks are dropping.

00:00:01:19 - 00:00:03:19
Rankings haven't changed.

00:00:03:19 - 00:00:05:16
Impressions are up.

00:00:05:16 - 00:00:08:00
Are you doing SEO right now?

00:00:08:00 - 00:00:09:24
Here's what's going on.

00:00:09:24 - 00:00:14:04
Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, Perplexity, and ChatGPT

00:00:14:10 - 00:00:17:19
are answering your users' questions before they ever click a link.

00:00:18:07 - 00:00:21:24
They're pulling content from across the web, synthesizing it

00:00:21:24 - 00:00:25:20
into a neat little answer, and citing whoever they think deserves the credit.

00:00:26:12 - 00:00:27:13
The problem?

00:00:27:13 - 00:00:30:15
Your existing SEO tools can't see any of this.

00:00:30:24 - 00:00:33:09
Rank trackers ignore AI answers.

00:00:33:09 - 00:00:37:06
Google Search Console blends AI-driven clicks into your overall traffic.

00:00:37:17 - 00:00:42:06
GA4 has no way to isolate LLM-originated visibility.

00:00:42:13 - 00:00:47:07
So how do you know if your brand is showing up in AI search results?

00:00:47:16 - 00:00:51:19
And more importantly, how do you know if your competitors are?

00:00:52:09 - 00:00:55:00
That's exactly what I'm going to show you today.

00:00:55:00 - 00:00:59:01
We are going to use Apify's Google Search Results Scraper to pull structured

00:00:59:01 - 00:01:02:08
data from Google AI Mode, Perplexity, and ChatGPT,

00:01:02:22 - 00:01:06:09
all in one run, and turn it into real intelligence

00:01:06:09 - 00:01:09:09
for your Answer Engine Optimization strategy.

00:01:09:16 - 00:01:12:07
Let's talk about why this all matters.

00:01:12:07 - 00:01:16:11
AEO is quickly becoming the next frontier of search marketing.

00:01:16:20 - 00:01:21:14
AI search engines don't just rank pages. They pick specific passages,

00:01:21:18 - 00:01:25:11
cite specific sources, and construct answers from them.

00:01:25:23 - 00:01:30:13
A page that ranks number ten on Google can get cited in an AI answer,

00:01:30:18 - 00:01:33:19
while the number one result gets ignored entirely.

00:01:33:19 - 00:01:37:09
And the tools that do track AI visibility? They're expensive.

00:01:37:17 - 00:01:41:13
Specialized AEO platforms charge hundreds of dollars a month.

00:01:42:00 - 00:01:45:21
Legacy tools like Semrush and Ahrefs have added AI features,

00:01:46:01 - 00:01:49:23
but they're usually locked behind higher-tier plans.

00:01:49:24 - 00:01:54:08
With Apify, you can get Google AI Mode results starting at two dollars per thousand results.

00:01:54:18 - 00:01:57:14
That's a fraction of what you'd pay anywhere else,

00:01:57:14 - 00:02:00:18
and you get Perplexity and ChatGPT data on top of that.

00:02:01:02 - 00:02:03:07
But it's not just about cost.

00:02:03:07 - 00:02:06:07
It's about what you can actually do with the data.

00:02:06:09 - 00:02:10:21
You can see exactly how each AI engine formulates its answer for a given query.

00:02:10:22 - 00:02:15:13
You can compare which sources get cited across Google AI Mode,

00:02:15:13 - 00:02:18:15
AI Overviews, Perplexity, and ChatGPT,

00:02:19:02 - 00:02:22:01
and spot where they agree or differ.

00:02:22:01 - 00:02:25:17
You can track how your competitors show up in AI answers

00:02:25:21 - 00:02:28:23
and figure out what content format the models prefer,

00:02:29:01 - 00:02:33:10
whether that's a listicle, a how-to guide, or something else.

00:02:33:15 - 00:02:37:08
And you can do all of this across multiple countries and languages.
